holderPosition.legalForm: Membership interest in a designated Series of SHIFT DAO LLC, a Marshall Islands series DAO LLC (DAO Act 2022, LLC Act 1996 s.79 segregation), whose treasury is documented to hold one daily-reset leveraged or inverse ETF (Series 17: SPXL, ISIN US25459W8626; Series 12: Direxion Daily TSLA X2, ISIN US25460G2865)
holderPosition.says: On the Series Operating Agreements the holder is a member and 'owner in the Series Assets', with 'treasury ownership only' and no voting, management, fiduciary or inspection rights. The issuer's own legal notice denies any 'legal title, or claims to the underlying Series Assets', no agreement names the mint it governs, and the two SpaceX mints have no Series or terms at all.

outside.says: The Series agreements, the Terms of Use, the Risk Disclosure and the site notice disagree on title, eligibility and redemption; nothing published ranks them.
RMI law; ICDR arbitration seated in the RMI with a total bar on court actions for Series members, RMI courts for website users, and ICC arbitration with a class waiver on the vaults Terms.

A percentage-of-treasury fee the Master DAO may charge is never quantified; on a Master Cancellation Event the Master DAO alone decides whether a Series continues or is wound up, at the Series' cost; cessation of membership gives no right to a distribution.
No NAV or mark is published; users trade on market makers' RFQ quotes 'based on the underlying ETF's NAV, plus a spread', with weekend spreads given as up to ~3% and up to ~5% on two docs pages.

ingredients.label: Series terms (T) that name this mint
A named custodian's ETF holdings for the Series, under 30 days
Reserve against supply from an independent oracle

verdict.summary: The outline can be said, and the defect is sayable too: the issuer's T and its own contrary notice side by side, flagged by a researcher. What the holder has, a series LLC membership interest whose link to the mint is undocumented, needs both the missing claim kind and a way to say which record is authoritative, both priority-1/2 gaps at the core. The custodians are named only by the issuer, the claimed Chainlink feed does not exist, the SpaceX mints have no terms, and every mint is Token-2022 under a single hot key.
